newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Process Auto shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Process Auto shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of electroplating machines distributor Process Automation (Holdings) Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Monday.
The company's shares gained HK$0.42 or 75 percent last week to end Friday at HK$0.98.
Process Automation also on Monday denied a sale of a controlling stake to third party China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd.

The company said it made the statement in response to market rumours of a sale of a controlling shareholding in the company or that the company would issue new shares to China Aerospace in exchange for an asset aquisition.
"The board would like to state that such reports and rumours are not true," the company said in the statement.
"The board declares that the company has not discussed with any Chinese enterprises about any proposal to raise share capital for the company," it added.
